issue.title: Context lane rows wrap the bead id to column 0 in narrow split Context cards
issue.description:
Found by the sase-18z.3 land agent while re-checking the narrow Context-card note preview golden (`tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/agents_bead_note_preview_120x40.png`).

In a narrow split Context card (~30 cells), the ARTIFACTS `Beads:` row built by `append_lane_row` (`src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/_agent_context_common.py`) is not width-aware: it always emits `_ROW_LEADING` + HH:MM:SS + the fixed-width role column + glyph + hint + bead id. Rich then soft-wraps it at a space, so `10:05:00  ✎` sits on one line and the bead id (`sase-visual.7 · noted ×2`) falls to column 0 on the next line, below the lane's left edge. The same row shape is shared by the MEMORY, ARTIFACTS reads, SKILLS, and WORKSPACES lanes, so they probably break the same way in narrow cards.

Not caused by sase-18z.3. Before that epic the whole bead section was built as 80-cell logical text and Rich rewrapped it the same way. sase-18z.3 made note previews and the `↳` reason line width-aware (the reason line now yields indent to keep 24 content cells), but not the row itself.

Suggested direction: pass the card `line_cell_limit` into `append_lane_row` (the bead section already threads it through `ResponsiveBeadTouchesSection`). When the full row would not fit, collapse the role column and/or drop the seconds and gap, so the bead id stays on the timestamp line or wraps with a hanging indent. Refresh the PNG golden after the change.

task_type_fields.impact: Cosmetic readability: in narrow and split Main deck Context cards the event rows lose their column alignment, and the bead id detaches from its timestamp.
task_type_fields.repro: Run 'just fix-tui-screenshots -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_sase_context.py' and inspect agents_bead_note_preview_120x40.png: the 'Beads:' row prints '10:05:00  ✎' and then 'sase-visual.7 · noted ×2' starting at column 0 on the next line.

payload.description: Epic that made note previews and read reasons card-width aware; this row is the remaining non-width-aware piece
